title: What If One Person Played All of Roblox?
description:
Roblox players logged nearly 34 billion hours. In just three months.

Sources:
- Gaming.net: Roblox Q3 revenue rises 16% as bookings fall 12% to $1.7 billion (Oct 2026): https://gaming.net/roblox-q3-revenue-rises-16-as-bookings-fall-12-to-1-7-billion
- Wikipedia: Roblox Corporation: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roblox_Corporation

Q3 2026 (from Roblox's shareholder letter as reported): nearly 34 billion hours engaged, 138 million daily active users, 30 million average monthly unique payers, $1.697 billion bookings. 34 billion hours / 8,766 hours a year = about 3.9 million years; 34 billion / 92 days / 138 million = about 2.7 hours a day (our math). Not financial advice.

#shorts #roblox #whatif #gaming #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you hop into Roblox, remember:
cta: Free or buy Robux? Comment which you are.

scenes.narration: Roblox players logged nearly 34 billion hours. In just three months.
Now give every hour to one person.
Playing nonstop? That's still about 3.9 million years.
But only 30 million people paid in a month.
Still, they spent 1.7 billion dollars in three months.

problems: The character model has no facial features, making it look broken and uncanny.
The text on screen frequently contradicts the narration (e.g., narration says 34 billion hours, screen shows 9 billion; narration says 30 million people, screen shows 30 million monthly payers).
The text 'q3 2026' appears on screen, which is in the future and confusing for a video about current stats.
The character's movements are stiff and robotic, appearing low-quality.
The cover image is generic and does not clearly communicate the 'how they make money' hook.
The text '0 PLAYER' and '1 PLAYER' is confusing and does not align with the narration's flow.
eyes.best_fix: Replace the faceless character model with a more expressive avatar and ensure all on-screen text perfectly matches the narration to avoid confusing the viewer.
